attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: article_category_matching
steps:
  - id: authenticate_drive_access
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "editorial_pipeline"
    output: auth_result

  - id: fetch_category_spreadsheet
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/integrations/google-drive/category-spreadsheet"
    output: raw_spreadsheet

  - id: validate_spreadsheet_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_spreadsheet
      schema: category_spreadsheet_schema
    output: validated_spreadsheet

  - id: read_extracted_article
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: extracted_articles
      filter: "status = 'pending_category'"
    output: raw_article

  - id: validate_article_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_article
      schema: extracted_article_schema
    output: validated_article

  - id: extract_article_title
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_article
      field: "title"
    output: article_title

  - id: normalise_article_title
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: article_title
      mapping:
        normalised_title: "lowercase(strip_accents(strip_non_alphanumeric(value)))"
    output: normalised_article_title

  - id: normalise_spreadsheet_titles
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_spreadsheet
      step: normalise_single_spreadsheet_row
    output: normalised_spreadsheet

  - id: normalise_single_spreadsheet_row
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_spreadsheet
      mapping:
        normalised_title: "lowercase(strip_accents(strip_non_alphanumeric(title)))"
        category: "category"
        section: "section"
        original_title: "title"
    output: normalised_row

  - id: apply_fuzzy_match_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "fuzzy_match"
      article_title: normalised_article_title
      candidates: normalised_spreadsheet
      match_field: "normalised_title"
      threshold: 0.85
    output: match_result

  - id: check_match_found
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "match_result.matched == true"
      true_step: extract_matched_category
      false_step: apply_default_category

  - id: extract_matched_category
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: match_result
      field: "matched_row"
    output: matched_category_data

  - id: build_matched_assignment
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: matched_category_data
      mapping:
        article_id: "validated_article.id"
        category: "category"
        section: "section"
        needs_review: false
    output: category_assignment

  - id: route_to_write_matched
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "true"
      true_step: write_category_assignment
      false_step: write_category_assignment

  - id: apply_default_category
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "assign_defaults"
      defaults:
        category: "Ciencia economica"
        section: "Dossier"
        needs_review: true
      article_id: validated_article
    output: default_result

  - id: build_default_assignment
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: default_result
      mapping:
        article_id: "validated_article.id"
        category: "defaults.category"
        section: "defaults.section"
        needs_review: true
    output: category_assignment

  - id: notify_editorial_review
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: category_assignment
      recipient: "editorial_team"
      message: "Article requires manual category review — no fuzzy match found."
    output: review_notification_result

  - id: write_category_assignment
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: category_assignment
      table: article_categories
    output: write_result

  - id: log_category_assignment
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: category_assignment
      action: "category_assigned"
      details: "Article category assignment completed"
    output: audit_log_result

  - id: end_workflow
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
dsl_type_errors: Step 'build_default_assignment': op 'transform_json' requires input of type 'records' but 'default_result' has type 'boolean'. Make sure the step producing 'default_result' uses an op that outputs a list of records (e.g. fetch_api, filter_records, validate_schema, read_database).
